name: runLaws-holds-the-error-of-a-law-at-rest
query: :d 1 | :d/addsToAString ::law~("x" | add 1) | ::d | runLaws | first | entries | filter ~(first | eq :error) | first | last | tag

name: the-laws-of-a-name-are-the-laws-declared-under-it-by-their-names
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| | :Box/addsUp |~~ Two and three is five. ~~| ::law~(2 | add 3 | eq 5) | ::Box | laws | keys

name: run-laws-names-each-law-by-its-address-and-its-claim-by-its-page
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| | :Box/addsUp |~~ Two and three is five. ~~| ::law~(2 | add 3 | eq 5) | ::Box | runLaws | first | get [/law /says /ok]
expect: [::Box/addsUp |~~ Two and three is five. ~~| true]

name: a-law-without-a-page-claims-nothing-it-says
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| | :Box/addsUp ::law~(2 | add 3 | eq 5) | ::Box | runLaws | first | get [/says /ok]

name: a-law-that-answers-false-fails
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| | :Box/wrong |~~ One is two. ~~| ::law~(1 | eq 2) | ::Box | runLaws | first | get /ok

name: a-law-reads-as-the-pair-of-its-page-and-its-query
query: :k 5 | :k/answersFive |~~ k answers five. ~~| ::law~(k | eq 5) | ::k | laws | get /answersFive | get [~(get /0 | content) /1]

name: the-tutorial-of-a-name-is-its-page-and-its-laws
query: :k |~~ Answers five. ~~| 5 | :k/answersFive |~~ k answers five. ~~| ::law~(k | eq 5) | ::k | tutorial | get [~(get /0 | content) ~(get /1 | keys)]

name: one-outcome-for-each-law
query: :three 3 | :three/isThree ::law~(3 | eq 3) | :three/exceedsTwo ::law~(3 | gt 2) | ::three | runLaws | count | eq (::three | laws | count)

name: the-laws-of-a-concept-run-through-its-noun
expect: |~~ The error's tag names its site. ~~|

name: every-example-of-the-core-passes
query: kinds | toVec | :ks it | map ~(manifest) | flat | :nodes it | get [~(ks) ~(nodes) ~(nodes | map ~(manifest) | flat)] | flat | every ~(runLaws | every /ok)

name: a-law-that-answers-false-holds-false-as-its-answer-and-no-error
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| | :Box/wrong |~~ One is two. ~~| ::law~(1 | eq 2) | ::Box | runLaws | first | get [/ok /actual /error]
